reasoning: The icon is an abstract UI layout toggle glyph (a 3x3 grid with one merged 2x1 solid block and seven hollow square cells). While it could loosely represent CSS grid layouts or dashboards in web design, to most users it reads as unidentifiable interface chrome and is easily confused with a calculator, calendar, or QR code at small sizes.
